evidence_type: Static REA/JADX decompilation of the owner's installed H1 Control APK; no target execution

findings.claim: No query command exists for game mode or spatial audio
findings.observation: Commands class exposes only getStatus(op=0x07), getTargetInfo(op=0x03) and setNoiseMode(op=0x08). getStatus encodes op 7 with function 0xFF and all-attribute mask.

findings.claim: Game/spatial values come only from pushed button events
findings.observation: handle() updates gameMode only for RealmeEvent feature 4 and spatialAudio only for feature 5. RealmeFrame defines exactly those two feature ids. No other state path sets them.

findings.claim: Status response cannot contain game/spatial/adaptive state
findings.observation: applySysInfo() handles only attribute 0 (battery), 13 (noise mode) and 14 (supported modes). No adaptive-noise attribute handled.
setNoiseMode writes command then immediately copies mode into state before any acknowledgement. Our fork changed this to pending-until-report.

limitations: Static decompilation of one installed artifact, not a runtime trace of every firmware or app version.
Absence of a command in this artifact is not proof that no other firmware exposes one.
